zh.title: NTSB稱陸戰隊一號險相撞前未與航管聯絡
zh.summary: 美調查指陸戰隊一號發生空中接近前未聯絡航管；先前曾有通訊不穩紀錄
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 27 日的報導，美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）表示，在發生一起空中接近（close call）事件前的關鍵時刻，駕駛總統專機「陸戰隊一號」（Marine One）的機組人員未能與航空管制（ATC）人員取得聯繫。
此外，美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）的資料顯示，在該起差點相撞的近距離接觸事件發生前幾天，陸戰隊一號與航管就曾有過接觸。相關紀錄指出，在該起險些相撞的事件發生之前，機組人員便一直在設法解決通訊不穩定的問題。目前相關單位尚未透露更多關於此事件的具體細節。

en.title: NTSB Says Crew Flying Marine One Failed To Contact ATC Before Close Call
en.summary: Marine One crew failed to contact ATC before near miss; communications were flaky days prior
body: According to a news report published by Simple Flying on August 27, 2026, the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) stated that the crew operating the Marine One aircraft failed to establish contact with air traffic control (ATC) moments before a close call incident occurred.

Additionally, flight data from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) show that Marine One and air traffic control had met days earlier. The aviation authority's records show that flight crews had to work around flaky communications before the near miss incident took place. The NTSB and FAA did not release further details.
